debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, CPI imminent, earnings in 10 days), lack of money flow confirmation (negative CMF), overbought oscillators (Stoch 73.38, Williams %R), and weak fundamental/sentiment conviction create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.
